name: std-version-history
description: std-version-history — wiki/CMS revision history with diff + rollback. Browses revisions; opens detail in `viewing_single`; compares two revisions in `comparing` with intrinsic version-diff; persists rollback. `RevisionManage` is a rebindable single-entity trait: a consumer rebinds it to its own entity via `linkedEntity`. `config.scopeField` names the Revision field holding the parent document id; a page-mounted `{id}` route param scopes INIT's own fetch, and a consumer forwards SHOW_HISTORY { key } (via a `listens` override) to rescope the feed to one document — empty scopeField (default) or no id keeps today's unfiltered global feed. Rollback and retry refetches stay scoped.

fields.name: documentId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the associated document.

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Specifies the kind of document this revision belongs to.

fields.name: versionNumber
fields.description: A sequential identifier representing the revision's order.

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user who made the change.

fields.name: authorName
fields.description: The name of the user who made the change.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The snapshotted body of the revision — plain text or the rich-text HTML a document-look record carries. Rollback hands the whole row back to the host, which restores content onto the source document.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: A brief explanation of the revision's changes.

fields.name: searchTerm
fields.description: The current search query the user submitted.

fields.name: scopeKey
fields.description: The parent document id the feed is currently scoped to, set by SHOW_HISTORY. Empty when browsing the unfiltered global feed.

Indicates the view has been closed or dismissed.
Signals a request to compare two versions.

Signals a revision has been successfully retrieved and is ready.
Indicates a failure to load revision data.

Indicates that a revision rollback operation was unsuccessful.
emits.synonyms: rollback failed, revert error, undo failure

events.name: Initialize
events.description: Optional route param delivered on mount (e.g. an :id page segment); scopes INIT's own fetch to rows whose scopeField equals id. Absent id or empty scopeField config keeps the unfiltered global feed.
events.synonyms: route id, deep link, initial scope

events.name: Revision loaded
events.description: Signals a revision has been successfully retrieved and is ready.

events.name: Revision rolled back
events.description: Indicates a revision has been successfully restored to a previous state.

events.name: Revision rollback failed
events.description: Indicates that a revision rollback operation was unsuccessful.
events.synonyms: rollback failed, revert error, undo failure

events.name: Revision load failed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load revision data.

events.name: Show History
events.description: Requests the revision feed scoped to one parent document; stores the key and refetches filtered by config.scopeField.
events.synonyms: view history, doc history, filter revisions

events.name: Open Revision
events.description: Signals a revision has been selected for viewing.

events.name: Rollback
events.description: Indicates a revision has been successfully reverted.

events.name: Close View
events.description: Indicates the view has been closed or dismissed.

events.name: Compare
events.description: Signals a request to compare two versions.

scopeField.label: Scope field
scopeField.description: Revision entity field holding the parent document's id. When set, a page-mounted {id} route param scopes INIT's fetch, and a SHOW_HISTORY { key } event rescopes the feed, to rows whose scopeField equals the id/key; rollback and retry refetches stay scoped too. Empty (default) or no id = unfiltered global feed, unchanged from prior behavior.
